content: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability.
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Connect to Harbor-Guest and enter your last name plus room number.
Breakfast is served from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM weekdays and 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM weekends. The buffet is $24 per adult and $12 per child ages 6 to 12.
Self-parking is $22 per night and valet parking is $35 per night, both with in-and-out privileges. EV charging is available on level 2.
The complimentary airport shuttle operates daily from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM and departs the hotel every 30 minutes.
The indoor pool is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. The fitness center is open 24 hours with room-key access.
Up to two dogs are allowed per room, each up to 50 lb. A non-refundable $75 cleaning fee applies. Service animals are welcomed without a pet fee.
Harbor Kitchen serves breakfast and dinner. Pier Cafe is open from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. In-room dining is available from 6:30 AM to 10:00 PM.
Standard flexible rates may be cancelled by 6:00 PM one day before arrival. Prepaid and promotional rates can differ. Guests should check their confirmation or contact hotel staff.
Accessible rooms, routes, parking, visual alarms, lowered fixtures, and a pool lift are available. Contact the hotel to confirm specific room features.
The waterfront promenade is a 5-minute walk, the Maritime Museum is 0.6 miles away, and the arts district is about 10 minutes by rideshare.
Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. For an active noise concern, guests should call the front desk.
